items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Benny Waters, he’s just fabulous... [INTERVIEWEE] We were listening to him this morning while he was playing.

ctx.x: So and the thing is though, that these guys and the 16 year olds are all trying to do the same thing. They’re all trying to make jazz. So you know they’re all going to the same place, which I think is just great.

And Benny Waters, he’s just fabulous. I mean I don’t hear that vibrato, you know like a person I mean that could play the instrument you know, 93 years old. You ain’t going to hear nothing like that, I mean he’s very swift. And he’s very commanding and — boom.
We were listening to him this morning while he was playing. And we all said gee, he sounds like Coleman Hawkins. And he would be contemporary.
